<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1136
Claimant:
Amber Jones
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
6-30-24
Claim reported by phone this morning after a hit while turinng left at an intersection, with the claimant describing a
neck strain and pain since the impact. Claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the
attorney's office.
7-20-24
Reviewed the photos submitted with the file, which confirm some of the details described, including the position of the
vehicles after the collision. No independent witnesses have come forward, but the responding officer's report places
the claimant in the vehicle at the scene.
7-26-24
Vehicle damage to the front quarter panel and bumper lines up with the impact described by the claimant and the
agnle of the turn. Appraiser's notes support the repair estimate as presented.
8-18-24
Confirmed with the policy records that the driver lives with the named policyholder and is covered as a household
member under the policy. No issues with coverage eligibility at this stage.
8-21-24
Checked the vehicle's prior claims and inspection history and found no earleir damage to the same areas. Nothing in
the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage period began.
9-10-24
Obtained the initial treatment records. The injury reported, a neck strain, fits the kind and force expected from this
type of collision.
10-11-24
Claimant's medical history shows no earlier injury to the neck or upper back. Treatment has followed a usual course
so far, with the frequency of visits decreasing as symptoms improved.
10-27-24
Spoke with the claimant again through counsel. The account of the collision matched what was given in the first
report and in each prior conversation, with no changes in the sequence of events.
11-5-24
Reviewed the latest treatment notes. Progress has been steady, the claimant reports less pain and reduced stiffness,
and the provider is tapering the plan toward discharge.
12-24-24
Updated the reserve to reflect the current treatment course and repair estimate. File remains open pending receipt of
the final treatment summary and the attorney's demand package.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
